parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider name, or "all" to combine all providers

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Restrict search to a provider token list

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Chain id, if omitted return gas for all chains

parameters.name: timeFrame
parameters.description: Time frame to get gas history

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Chain id, if omitted return gas for all chains

parameters.name: timeFrame
parameters.description: Time frame to get gas history

providerMapping.description: Mapping of provider names to their token identifiers

hash.description: Hash for the first transaction broadcasted by the end user. e.g. `88D1819378ECD09E5284C54937CDC1E99B52F253C007617A02DD1200710CE677`

block.description: Block number. Required for Polkadot chain. e.g. `123456`

depositChannelId.description: Deposit channel ID, required for Chainflip if tx was broadcasted without wallet connection

depositAddress.description: Deposit address associated with a deposit channel

slippage.description: Slippage tolerance as a percentage. Default is 3%.

cfBoost.description: Set to true to enable CF boost to speed up Chainflip swaps. BTC only.

useConfidentialIntents.description: Set to true to request a confidential swap through NEAR Intents. NEAR provider only, requires Confidential Intents access (invite-only).

quoteType.description: EXACT_INPUT (default) or FLEX_INPUT. On FLEX_INPUT, routes whose first-leg provider can't honour the mode are filtered out. Supported first-leg providers: THORCHAIN, MAYACHAIN, CHAINFLIP (incl. streaming variants), NEAR, and FLASHNET.

disableEstimate.description: Set to true to disable on-chain estimation

enableSweep.description: Set to true to enable sweeping wallet funds when the transaction would otherwise leave unspendable dust in the address (opt-in).

maxExecutionTime.description: Maximum execution time in seconds. Routes exceeding this time will be filtered out.

affiliateFee.description: Affiliate fee in basis points. This should only be used as an override, for example when you have some rebate or discount program. If not provided, the fees configured in your API Key will be used.

previousLegProvider.description: The provider of the previous leg in the route, if any

nextLegProvider.description: The provider of the next leg in the route, if any

inbound.description: Time to receive inbound asset in seconds

swap.description: Time to swap assets in seconds

outbound.description: Time to receive outbound asset in seconds

previousLegProvider.description: The provider of the previous leg in the route, if any

nextLegProvider.description: The provider of the next leg in the route, if any

quoteType.description: The quoteType this route was built for (EXACT_INPUT or FLEX_INPUT). Echoes the request's quoteType so /swap can carry the mode forward.

minAmount.description: Provider minimum sell amount (human units), when the provider reported one

routeId.description: The ID of the route to swap

quoteType.description: Override the EXACT_INPUT/FLEX_INPUT mode for this swap. Defaults to the quoteType from the original /v3/quote request when omitted.

destinationAddress.description: Recipient address to send asset to

allowSmartContractSender.description: Whether to allow smart contract sender

allowSmartContractReceiver.description: Whether to allow smart contract receiver

overrideSlippage.description: Whether to override slippage validation on quote refresh

disableBuildTx.description: Set to true to skip building a transaction. Used when you build a custom transaction from our response.

enableSweep.description: Set to true to enable max-spend sweep behaviour for UTXO/gas assets (opt-in).

previousLegProvider.description: The provider of the previous leg in the route, if any

nextLegProvider.description: The provider of the next leg in the route, if any

inbound.description: Time to receive inbound asset in seconds

swap.description: Time to swap assets in seconds

outbound.description: Time to receive outbound asset in seconds

previousLegProvider.description: The provider of the previous leg in the route, if any

nextLegProvider.description: The provider of the next leg in the route, if any

shieldedMemo.description: Shielded ZEC source only: send a 0-value shielded note carrying the memo to this unified address, in the SAME transaction as the value output to inboundAddress

unifiedAddress.description: Maya's unified address that receives the 0-value shielded memo note

uivk.description: Maya's unified incoming viewing key used to decrypt the memo note

memo.description: Memo to include in the transaction

to.description: Hex-encoded recipient address (native TRX) or TRC-20 token contract address

data.description: ABI-encoded TRC-20 transfer parameters, or 0x for native TRX

memo.description: Transaction memo to attach on-chain: either a plain-text provider memo (e.g. THORChain) or a 0x-prefixed hex byte payload (e.g. Chainflip vault swap parameters), which must be attached as raw bytes

sendMode.description: Optional @ton/ton SendMode bitmask. Set to 130 (CARRY_ALL_REMAINING_BALANCE | IGNORE_ERRORS) on sweeps so the wallet sends balance − fees instead of the literal amount.

quoteType.description: The quoteType this route was built for (EXACT_INPUT or FLEX_INPUT). Echoes the request's quoteType so /swap can carry the mode forward.

isRefreshed.description: Indicates if the quote was refreshed

isWrapped.description: Indicates if the tx is wrapped

isSweep.description: True when the request was treated as a max-spend sweep (sellAmount adjusted for gas/fees).

signedTxString.description: Exact byte string that was SHA-256 hashed and ES256-signed (RFC 8785 canonical JSON for object txs, or the raw serialized tx for string txs). Verify `signature` over these literal bytes — no re-serialization needed.

swapId.description: The unique swap ID for tracking

quoteCreatedAt.description: Creation timestamp of the underlying quote (ISO 8601)

approvalTx.description: Optional approval transaction if ERC-20 approval is required before swap
